definitions.definition: Two formulae are equisatisfiable if they are both satisfiable or both unsatisfiable.
An algorithm that converts a formula ϕ to an equisatisfiable formula ϕ' in CNF with size linear in the size of ϕ, by introducing a fresh variable for each AST node.
